text:
Hi my love
I missed you
How are you? Are you tired?
I keep thinking about you every day.
Most of the time I think about you for random things. I see things you like, I hear a song and think you would love it.
They say that what makes a place beautiful is the sensitivity of the person who sees it.
I distract myself watching the wind blowing through the leaves and the raindrops on the window.
And when I look at the sky, I wonder if the moon is appearing for you tonight.
Even with time passing, I am happy to feel that my life has you by my side.
That I can see what you paint, I can see your smile and we grow older.
Thank you for today's gift and for all the gifts you give me every day for being my Hwang Hyunjin.

joy

author: @amywithsnakes
text:
Its been 4 months and this song still brings me to tears with just the beginning melody. 

For me this feels like longing for the person one used to be. We all change as we age- we become two different people even though we share the same body.

I constantly look back at my younger self, I was happier, I smiled more, I experienced and explored life. Presently I have little to no motivation to do even basic errands, I struggle to maintain friendships, true smiling and happiness doesn't come easy. I constantly miss who I used to be.

Thank you, Hyunjin, for turning poetry and art into beautiful music and lyrics.

author: @Cherrrryssspoison
text: I love you, Hwang Hyunjin, with all my soul. I love you not only as a talented idol, not only as a media personality, not only as a person who only entertains others by memorizing the script, but as you, the real you: you smiling, you laughing, rejoicing in all sorts of little things, drawing amazing drawings that sometimes reflect your mental anguish, but there is something in them something native, something that gives hope that our emotions and experiences are similar. I love you dancing so that your soul draws smooth and refined movements, from which it is impossible to take your eyes off. I have little chance of even getting to the concert, but despite the fact that our meeting will not happen soon or never, I will still love and appreciate you. Looking at how you try to improve yourself day after day, feeling your scrupulous love for us, for Stay, I want to give you all the most beautiful things in this world, because you deserve it. Please remember that the world is full of love and you deserve it in full. Feel it every day. Keep shining not only for the world, but also for yourself, for your loved ones. Appreciate your efforts and know that you are doing enough. Even if I'm just a stupid sixteen-year-old Stay, even if I can't even get to one of the concerts and feel real happiness with a boiling heart, even if you don't know about my existence, even if you feel unimportant on certain days, even if you have a loved one to whom you are ready to give yourself I will still love, appreciate and respect you with the lightest love in the world, you will still unconsciously give me faith for the best, you will still be my motivation and inspiration for great deeds. I'm proud of you, okay? And I will always be on your side. Thank you so much, thank you for being there, thank you for being alive and well, thank you for sharing your love with the world, thank you for being so sincere, thank you for your healing voice, thank you.Thank you and 2022 for introducing me to you. Be healthy, happy and loved. I love you, Hwang Hyunjin. You make me alive, you make me real Stay🫂❤️‍🩹

love you always

author: @h-playwithmyhart.4806
text: Hyunjin. It was certainly your musicality that drew me to you first. You have such a playful but easy tone which highlights and gives definition to every Stray Kids song. You don’t have fixated or set rapping style. You are very experimental vocally and lyrically and I’ve found myself charmed by your voice due the versatility of it. I also love your singing style for similar reasons. You are just as diverse of a singer as you are rapper. It is really peaceful and harmonious; and blends perfectly with the rest of your members. I love how you don’t hold anything back when you’re singing and I can really feel the emotion and work that you pour into each line that you sing. Similarly to your singing and rapping, your body knows no limits when you are met with a choreography. You dance with a ferocity and a passion that no other performers can possess. You take each choreography and sincerely make it your own, which is honestly a blessing to watch. When you are dancing, you can be yourself and express your emotions with the beauty of your body movements. You can lose yourself easily into your dance and you are so comfortable and trusting of your own abilities. For this generation specifically, you have transformed music and given new meaning to what it can and should do for people. You are changing the world each day that you continue to share your artistry and dance; and we are so lucky to be alive right now to get to be a part of the history that you’re making. At the same time that I love your music and dance, I love your personality as well. I love that sometimes you keep to yourself, but other times, you are goofy and outgoing. As I mentioned before, you are extremely freeing to be around and those who spend time with you can relax and be themselves in your presence. I know that nobody can attest to these qualities quite like your members. Seven different personalities, and they all love you and cherish you for their own special reasons. They’ve looked to you and have modeled their perseverance off of how you strive to not let the difficult times hold you down and prevent you from success. You have opened your heart up to all seven people, although you come from different backgrounds, and that has encouraged them to all to have such a loving relationship with one another. You’ve had love for them since you began your journey with them and this has establishing a lifelong love that all of you had before you even debuted. You see the beauty and necessity of every single member and constantly remind them how important they are to Stray Kids. There is likely no greater feeling for them than knowing that they have you by their side if they don’t have anything else. The most important takeaway is the time they spend with you and the way you make them feel, and these are both filled with warm memories they can take with them for the rest of their lives. You’ve already spent some of the happiest and life-changing moments of your life with them, and there is still more to come. The members of Stray Kids, also your brothers and your family, couldn’t have somebody who loves them any more than you do to look after them. You are always so considerate of them and their feelings and respond to them however they need. They are the best versions of themselves because of you and because you love them just the way they are. Now, they can go on to do whatever they aspire to because you’ve encouraged them with that confidence. I want to personally thank your parents and family for raising you and helping you become the person you are today. I know they mean a lot to you, and that you couldn’t be here doing what you are without their love and support. Because of them, you can use your platform to share with the world the same love that they have provided you with your whole life. I hope you never forget that they are always going to be the most proud of you no matter what you do. They love you most in this world and they do so in a way that nobody else understands. Stay love them as you do and we keep them in our hearts as we continue our time with you. We are so grateful to them for bringing you into the world, and for changing the world the same way that you do. Hyunjin, you touch each individual heart of every Stay, and this is easily one of the most charming parts about you. It is in your nature to make each and every Stay feel special, even if you don’t know us personally. You welcome Stay from all around the world with open arms, and I felt as if I was a part of the family my whole life. You are so dedicated to your Stay and this is very apparent in everything that you do, whether it be performing or communicating with us directly. You have so much compassion for Stay and I feel like we are existing in our own separate world with you. Although we all live in different areas across the world, you take us to a place where we can all be one big family together, and it is one of the greatest feelings in the world. What you give to us is irreplaceable, and there could never be another person who helps us see the worth in ourselves the way you do. You also help us love one another. You influence others to treat others with kindness and I’ve met some of the most heartwarming Stay. I know that you help this family become closer every single day, and you remind us that if we have nothing else, we have each other. You invite us into your heart, the same way that you do your members, and you see qualities in us that we don’t even see ourselves. I know for a fact that there are Stay who only believe in themselves because of you. You also share so much of yourself with us, and this is perhaps one of the biggest ways you can show somebody that you trust. As time goes on, I notice you revealing more of yourself through your music and just through direct conversation with your Stay. You have gotten so personal with us and this lets us know just how much you actually believe in us and trust us to keep these parts of you within our hearts. There is no greater honor than to have you place this vulnerable side of you in our hands, and we want to do the same for you. I know that it is not always easy to do this, so I hope you know that we could never mislead you or betray your trust if we wanted to. You are one of the most generous people we know, and we could not be here giving love to others and to you without the love that you gave us first. I know that you’ve been through a lot, both personally, and professionally, and that your time as an idol has not always been easy or enjoyable. You have been active for several years now, but during your training period alone, you’ve been met with demanding expectations, which many people cannot even say they’ve undergone. Just as your family is, Stay could not be more proud of you from overcoming your hardships and making it out on the brighter side. Each time you are met with a grueling time or task, thought it make time, you eventually endure through it until the end, and become more experienced. As Stay, I can say we learn so much from how you choose to release stress or convey how you’re feeling through the mediums that provide you comfort.  We are beyond proud of you and continue to learn from you each day. I hope that this birthday makes all of your dreams come true, and you can take the time to truly celebrate who you are as a person. I know it might be difficult to focus on yourself, and if you find this to be the case, I hope you leave it to those who surround you and your admiring fans from all across the world to help you realize how revolutionary of a person you are. You are truly a gifted musician, and a courteous and selfless individual. You deserve this day, and every day that follows, to feel as appreciated as you truly are. I hope that every second is filled with memories that are unforgettable, and that this will be one of the greatest days that you’ve had! Please have fun and celebrate in whatever way you choose, because your Stay will be cheering with you!  Thank you for sacrificing your time, efforts, pain, doubt, fear, tears, emotions, and physical boundaries just to bring us any content at all. For every effort that you put in that you might think is small, a Stay’s mood or day is completely changed for the better. You are blessing to this world and continue to change it every day with how you choose to heal it and the people living in it. I hope you don’t overwork yourself because you are perfect just the way you present yourself to us. We will support you and be there for you for the rest of our lives! I pray that you and your loved ones stay safe, and find happiness and worth in the future. Happy birthday Hyunjin, and we adore you so much!

text:
My dearest Hyunjin,

Firstly let me start by expressing my heartfelt gratitude for all the joy and inspiration you have brought into my life As a loving fan you have meant more me than words can ever truly to convey

Your talent and dedication keeps amazing me Every stage performance every new release, and every effort you put into your craft has never failed to leave me in awe your hard work and perseverance have been a source of motivation for me to pursue my own dreams reminding me that with passion and determination anything is possible

But it is not just your music that has impacted me profoundly Your genuine kindness and humility shine through even amidst the unfathomable fame and success you have achieved Your willingness to use your platform to spread positivity and meaningful messages to your fans has touched my heart deeply
In my darkest moments your music has been a ray of light lifting my spirits and reminding me that I am not alone. Your lyrics have resonated with my own experiences giving me solace and a sense of belonging Your passion has become an escape for me a place where I can forget my worries and immerse myself in the magic you create.

I just wanted to take this moment to express my deepest appreciation for all that you have done for me and your countless fans around the world. Your genuine talent, hard work, kindness, and the impact you have made within the Kpop industry and beyond are truly remarkable. I am forever grateful to be able to witness your journey and be a part of your fandom.

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for being an inspiration and bringing so much happiness into my life. Please remember that, no matter what challenges you may face, your fans will always be here to support you
I love you ♡

I hope Hyunjin continues to create as I will also continue to create my own artworks. He's a type of person I will talk about to other people when I grow older and older. author: @yj894
text:
“Let's JYPE hear us out and support Hyunjin.  If anyone who reads this and agrees, please cut and paste in your comment”

I am not a Stay, I am just an adult woman living in overseas, who happened to run into a Hyunjin’s video clip on Youtube, gradually got to know him due to its algorithm and became interested in him. I'm worried, first of all, about Hyunjin how the recent situation will once again impact him mentally and emotionally.  So I'm posting here in hope that someone from JYPE can see this. 
I think the reason Hyunjin’s past matter keeps rising to the surface is because JPYE’s elementary response/problem solving was poor in the beginning. When I first look at the details of Hyunjin's bullying incident, I think it was not a school violence, but a “situation” that could easily happen between children in puberty. However, JPY saw business potential in Hyunjin, so they didn’t kick him out, but instead, had Hyunjin write a personal but public apology which made it look as if Hyunjin truly committed and admitted the school violence.  This was all because JPYE was so conscious about their company image but not because they care about their artists like they claim, wasn’t it?  
If you had decided to accept him in, JYPE should have fought the issue, made the public aware it wasn’t a case of school violence/bullying.  As a result of your poor approach to the matter, those who are careless about Hyunjin would sabotage him in worst possible way and in every opportunity they have.  To me, Hyunjin is more a victim here than anyone else.  He is only a young talented person who loves to sing and dance and who is an inspiration to many people and kids in this world.  Please, clean up the issue thoroughly this time so that there are no more accusations against Hyunjin for the same incident in the future. Hyunjin is a person before he is a K-pop idol.

text:
"JPYE에 우리의 목소리를 전달하고 현진이를 응원합시다.  이 글을 읽고 동의 하시는 분은 본인의 계정에 복사해 올려주세요"
나는 스테이도 아니고 단지 현진이라는 아이를 우연히 유툽에서 보게 되고 유툽 알고리즘에 의해 조금씩 그 아이를 알게 되고 관심을 가지게 된 어른 여자입니다.  최근의 상황이 현진이에게 또 다시 얼마나 무거운 마음의 짐을 지게 하는 일인지 미리 걱정되어 여기에, 혹시라도 JYPE의 관계자가 볼수 있지 않을까 해서 올립니다. 현진이의 일이 자꾸만 표면위로 떠오르는 것은 JPY의 초등대응/문제해결이 미숙했었던거라고 생각해요. 처음 현진이의 bulling 사건의 내용을 보면 학폭이 아니고 사춘기때 아이들 끼리 얼마든지 벌어질수 있는 “상황”이었다고 봅니다.  그런데 JPY는 현진이에게서 사업적인 가능성이 보이니 내치지는 않고 인성을 중요시 한답시는 외부 시선은 의식되니 지난 날의 잘못이 어쩌고.. 현진이한테 공개적 반성문 쓰게 하고.. 현진이를 끌어앉고 갈 생각이었으면 깨끗하게 학폭이 아니고 어렸을 때 사건으로 인한 쌍방의 견해의 차이로 결론지었어야 했지요.  현진이가 반성문 쓰게 해서 “학폭”을 인정한 것 처럼 보이게 만들고.. 번번이 이게 들춰들춰질 때 마다 침묵하고..  이렇게 일 처리를 했으니 세상의 모든 사람이 현진이를 지지하고 응원하진 않을 테니 그렇지 않은 일부가, 관종들이 기회가 있을 때 마다 자꾸 이 문제를 들춰낼 수 밖에. 나에게는 현진이가 언론과 상업적 이익만을 추구 하는 K-Pop의 엔터기업의 피해자로 보여요.  그저 춤추고 노래하기 좋아하는 재능 많은 아이인데 이제 이 일로 또 얼마나 힘들어 할지...  너무 마음이 아픕니다.  이번엔 확실히 정리해 주시길 바랍니다.  그게 현진이를 위한 일이고 JYPE의 장기적 발전을 위한 길이기도 합니다.  말로만 인성이 어쩌고 하지 말고 소속 아티스트를 진심으로 염려하고 걱정하고 위하는 기업이 되어 주세요.

author: @lorenacarfaro
text:
Hyunjin, you might never read this, but I need you to know how it is for us.

We, true STAY. 
We, people from all around the world who feel grateful for meeting you guys.
We, who laugh when you laugh, and cry when you cry. 
We, who know stray kids has 8 members, love the 8 members and know it's 8 or nothing.
We, who love each one of your songs, but also the amount of love and care for each other. 
We, who don't imagine our lives without you guys. 
We, who promised forever. 
Who promised we'll STAY. 

For us, Stray Kids is our joy, our inspiration.
You are our friends, our family, the brothers we never had. 
Our love is real. And so is our loyalty. 

True STAY love Stray Kids. They protect them. They take care of them. 

True STAY don't go hating on the members (from SKZ or any other group).

True STAY don't force you to do things you don't feel confortable, don't demand information you choose to keep private and NEVER hurt you. 

True STAY might identify more with one or another, but always love the 8. 
We know it couldn't be different. 
You guys were meant to be.

True STAY are supportive and caring.

Because we understood the message. SKZ's message. 
We are authentic, caring, funny and unique.  

So, basically what I am saying is: 
RELY ON US. LET US BE YOUR SHIELD. WE WILL ALWAYS LOVE AND PROTECT YOU. 

Even if you ever make a mistake, we'll protect you. Not because you're perfect and we're blind, but because you're human and we love you. 

I know there is a lot of darkness out there, and sometimes being a huge success come with this unfair price of free hate. But let me remind you, it is worth it. 

What we are building here, it's worth it. 

We're making history. 
We're making art. 
We're shaking the world. 

So let's continue, together. 

When you're stray, we will STAY. FOREVER.

author: @BloomzMember
text:
Oh my! 👏👏👏 Wonderful job to all that made this happen.
Hyunjin's voice ... soft, telling the story, then speaking slightly faster, explaining, almost a pleading. Then just... stopped.
The music! Also starting so softly, building simply, in volume and intensity, then the guitars - to me, the music itself represented how longing and love starts. And changes or ends.  There was a rawness, an edge brought by the mix of orchestra AND guitar that cleanly and clearly supported the message of the song.
Maybe it's because I'm older and have lived awhile, loved and lost.  Maybe it's because I'm on the way to the movies, by myself. 
...  I felt this song at my core! ...
Thank you Hyunjin and friends. I had a good cry and was incredibly grateful that someone else could relate to that feeling and express it so much better than I ever could.
🕊🫰🦋🇺🇸

text:
I absolutely love the emotions Hyunjin has conveyed through this song. It's so raw, and like he is becoming more and more vulnerable as the song goes on. 
My interpretation is that it is about a relationship that is starting to fall out, the other may be distancing or has left, and the song represents the one that still wants to love the other, holding onto the memories they have made for one another. 
Whatever happens to a relationship, we still want to hold at least one thing, no matter what. That way we still have an indirect connection to something that once meant the world to us.

author: @fanatkadicaprio
text:
Я с каждым разом все больше и больше восхищаюсь Хёнджином…
Он правда невероятный человек.
Очень талантливый, красивый , душевный , добрый… Я могу еще очень долгое говорить об его хороших качествах.
Когда я начала слушать эту песню, у меня мурашки побежали по телу..
Я была в таком приятном удивлении…
Голос Хёнджина такой красивый, такой сладкий.
Знаете , я бы сравнила его с мёдом. Он такой тягучий , мягкий и приятный.
Вот правда , я так сильно восхищаюсь этим парнем.
Его лирика всегда такая глубокая и имеет огромный смысл. Но помимо смысла , когда он поет он передает эти чувства… Чувства которые он хочет передать слушателям…
Хенджин невероятно творческий человек.
Я называю его «человек искусство» , «муза». Хенджин всегда вдохновляет меня!!
Его рисунки такие прекрасные, это правда произведение искусства…
Мне нравится тот, как он видит вещи вокруг , мне нравится то , как он показывает свои чувства.
Мне так приятно что Хенджин всегда показывает нам свои разные стороны, так мы узнаем его все лучше и лучше.

Наш драгоценный Хенджин , ты невероятный , прекрасный человек. Мы видим как трудно и упорно ты трудишься, как становишься все лучше и лучше. Твое стремление, труд, упорную работу мы видим. И ты каждый раз делаешь даже больше, чем мы ожидаем увидеть….
Твой голос , твои картины - они греют наши души.
Мы видим твой прогресс и очень гордимся тобой. 
Очень хочется подарить тебе всю любовь в этом мире, хочется чтобы все люди вокруг сказали что ты талант!
Ты заслуживаешь эти слова , поверь нам.
Спасибо тебе за все что ты делаешь, спасибо за то что ты есть🤍

Стэй - всегда будут с тобой , стэй - всегда будут любить тебя.
Стэй - навсегда останутся!

Любим тебя , наш талантливый мальчик Хван Хёнджин🤍🎀
